releasePlan.notes: Flag gates the player callsign login overlay in invaders.html init(). control path: loginOverlay hidden, showOverlay('GALACTIC DEFENDER',...) called directly — identical to pre-PR behavior. v1 path: loginOverlay shown, callsign captured, stored in localStorage, reflected in HUD and ldClient.identify(). loginOverlay HTML given display:none default so no flash before init() runs. isTypingTarget guard on keydown/keyup is unflagged (safe standalone improvement). loginForm submit listener is registered unconditionally (form is hidden in control so it is inert).
